name: Keekan SEO
author: keekan

sections.description:
Keekan SEO is a revenue-focused SEO plugin for WordPress designed for site owners, publishers, and businesses that want more than SEO scores — they want rankings, buyer-intent traffic, and monetization.

Instead of chasing random keywords, Keekan SEO helps you focus on high-intent opportunities, streamline content creation, and build pages designed to rank on Google and convert visitors into revenue.

Why Keekan SEO

Most WordPress SEO plugins focus on checklists and scores.
Keekan SEO focuses on outcomes.

  • Target buyer-intent and high-RPM keywords
  • Optimize pages for search engines and conversions
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to scale content
  • Keep your site fast with a lightweight architecture
  • Build SEO strategies around revenue, not vanity traffic

SEO Features

On-Page SEO
* Meta title and meta description management
* Open Graph and social media previews
* Search appearance controls
* SEO-friendly templates for metadata

XML Sitemaps
* XML sitemap generator
* Index sitemaps and taxonomy sitemaps
* Search-engine friendly sitemap structure

Schema & Structured Data
* Schema markup controls
* Structured data for better search visibility

SEO Audits
* On-page SEO audits
* Actionable and prioritized recommendations
* Technical and content-level insights

Keyword Research & Insights
* Keyword opportunity discovery
* Buyer-intent keyword signals
* RPM-based prioritization indicators

AI Content & Automation
* AI-assisted content drafts
* Scalable content workflows
* Optional automated publishing pipelines

Analytics & Monitoring
* SEO health overview
* Content performance visibility
* Revenue-oriented SEO insights inside WordPress

Use Cases

Keekan SEO is ideal for:

  • Publishers and niche content websites
  • Job portals and directory-style websites
  • High-volume blogging and content teams
  • Businesses targeting buyer-intent keywords
  • SEO professionals managing scalable projects
  • Monetization-focused WordPress sites

Local + Cloud Architecture

Keekan SEO runs essential SEO features locally on your WordPress site, including on-page SEO, schema, and sitemaps.

Advanced AI, keyword intelligence, and analytics features connect securely to Keekan Cloud using a connection token.

This hybrid approach ensures:
* Fast performance
* Minimal server load
* Powerful AI-driven SEO capabilities
sections.installation:
1. Upload the keekan-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate Keekan SEO through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Keekan SEO from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Connect your Keekan account using your token to enable cloud-based AI features.
sections.faq:
Is Keekan SEO free?

Core on-page SEO, schema, and sitemap features are available locally. Advanced AI and analytics features require a Keekan account.

Does Keekan SEO guarantee first-page rankings?

No. SEO depends on many factors. Keekan SEO helps you focus on buyer-intent opportunities and efficient execution.

Is Keekan SEO lightweight?

Yes. Assets are loaded only where needed to keep your site fast.

Is this an AI SEO plugin?

Yes. Keekan SEO includes AI-assisted workflows for keyword insights and content creation when connected to Keekan Cloud.

Does it work with caching and CDNs?

Yes. Keekan SEO is compatible with caching plugins and content delivery networks.

Who should use Keekan SEO?

Keekan SEO is built for site owners who care about rankings, conversions, and revenue, not just SEO scores.
